_README: Golden-test fixture. Exercises every branch of h3build that no real episode reaches: per-pass/sequence/shot model, lora and steps; a LoRA whose step count disagrees; clone mode with a track so audio windows work; explicit policies and retentions; continuous sequences; a speaker with no voice sample; a subject with no kind; render profiles at sequence and shot level.
